goal: Build a small RBI regulatory/legal corpus pipeline for downloading RBI PDFs, extracting text, cleaning it, and producing JSONL files for downstream RAG, rule generation, or training workflows.

pipeline.description: Store RBI PDF metadata and direct PDF URLs.

scripts.purpose: Extracts text from downloaded PDFs using pdfplumber first, with PyMuPDF fallback.
Builds processed JSONL and supports chunking.
